current.text: He is a backup center for the Lakers behind Walker Kessler and is not expected to start.
Experts call him a weak backup and say he is washed. If he plays in meaningful games, the Lakers are in trouble.
The backup center job is an open question. Mamukelashvili should get those minutes ahead of him.
The Lakers' defense depends heavily on Kessler. If Kessler is out, they would have to rely on Looney or Mamukelashvili.

durable.text: He makes almost no threes and scores very little.
He is not a pick-and-roll threat on offense.

note: Looney is not a draft option for us. Yahoo ranks him 396 and ESPN ranks him 291, both value him at 0 USD, and our league drafts only 144 players. His projected line of about 4.5 points and 6 rebounds in roughly 15 minutes gives almost nothing outside a decent TO number. Watch him only if Kessler gets hurt, and even then Mamukelashvili is the first Lakers center to look at on waivers.
